extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, stakeholders, policymakers, and researchers analyzing PTAB AIA proceeding outcomes
extracted.subtask_description: Fiscal Year 2023 statistical roundup of PTAB AIA proceedings (IPR and PGR) including counts, rates, outcome categories, and definitions of how key metrics are calculated. Intended to present trends and measurement definitions for petitions, patents, claims, institutions, settlements, and case-ending events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trial types (IPR and PGR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Trial types include Inter Partes Review (IPR) and Post Grant Review (PGR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report separates petitions and statistics by these trial types; FY23 had 1,209 IPRs (98%) and 30 PGRs (2%) of 1,239 total petitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions filed by technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Technology categories used for filing breakdown: Mechanical & Business Method; Chemical; Bio/Pharma; Design; Electrical/Computer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FY23 counts shown (e.g., Electrical/Computer 861, 69%); the report uses these categories to analyze filing distribution across technologies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions filed by month (temporal distribution)
rubrics_metrics.description: Monthly counts of petitions filed across a 12-month period (Sept 1, 2022 to Sept 30, 2023) broken out by trial type (IPR and PGR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides monthly trend visualization and raw counts to observe filing seasonality or spikes; distinguishes IPR vs PGR monthly filing volume.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution rate (by petition) — calculation
rubrics_metrics.description: Institution rate for each technology is calculated by dividing petitions instituted by decisions on institution (i.e., petitions instituted plus petitions denied).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outcomes of decisions on institution responsive to requests for rehearing are excluded from the calculation. Charts present institution/denial counts and percentages by fiscal year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution rate (by patent)
rubrics_metrics.description: Institution rate reported at the patent-level (percent of patents instituted vs denied) across fiscal years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report presents by-patent institution/denial percentages and counts for FY19–FY23; this is a patent-centric analogue to the by-petition institution rate (used to observe institution trends controlling for multiple petitions to the same patent).

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution rates by technology (FY23)
rubrics_metrics.description: Institution rates broken out by technology for FY23 (e.g., Bio/Pharma 52% (43 of 82); Chemical 49% (23 of 47); Electrical/Computer 70% (492 of 701); etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculated as petitions instituted divided by decisions on institution for the technology; rehearing-responsive decisions excluded. Useful for cross-technology comparison of institution likelihood.

rubrics_metrics.name: Settlement rate — calculation
rubrics_metrics.description: Settlement rate is calculated by dividing total settlements by concluded proceedings in each fiscal year (i.e., denied institution, settled, dismissed, requested adverse judgment, and final written decision).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Joined cases are excluded from the calculation. The report provides FY19–FY23 settlement counts and rates, and distinguishes Pre‑Institution vs Post‑Institution settlements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Settlement timing classification (Pre‑Institution vs Post‑Institution)
rubrics_metrics.description: Settlements are categorized as Pre‑Institution or Post‑Institution depending on whether they occurred before or after institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report provides counts for pre- and post-institution settlements each fiscal year (e.g., FY23: Post‑Institution 243, Pre‑Institution 259) to show when settlements typically occur.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes reported by petition — FWD reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: FWD (Final Written Decision) patentability or unpatentability is reported with respect to the claims at issue in the FWD; joined cases are excluded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reporting outcomes by petition, only petitions with FWDs are considered for patentability/unpatentability outcomes; joined cases are left out of these counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes reported by patent — FWD and Mixed Outcome definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: "Mixed Outcome" is shown for patents receiving more than one type of outcome from the list of: denied, settled, dismissed, and/or requested adverse judgment only. A patent is listed in a FWD category if it ever received a FWD, regardless of other outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When aggregating outcomes at the patent level, a patent may be in multiple outcome categories across proceedings; the 'mixed' label is applied when more than one non‑FWD outcome type occurred. This affects interpretation of patent-level outcome distributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claim outcomes and 'No DI' / 'No FWD' definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: 'No DI' and 'No FWD' mean the claim was challenged but not addressed in a Decision on Institution (DI) or Final Written Decision (FWD), e.g., due to settlement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report notes that 30% of challenged claims and 51% of instituted claims were found unpatentable by a preponderance of the evidence in FY23; 'No DI/No FWD' flags help explain why some challenged claims lack DI/FWD dispositions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Events that end an AIA proceeding (end-state categories)
rubrics_metrics.description: Events that end an AIA proceeding include final written decisions (FWD), settlements, dismissals, requests for adverse judgment, and denials of institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report uses these end-state categories when counting concluded proceedings for settlement rates and other fiscal‑year summaries; joined cases are excluded from certain calculations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joined cases exclusion policy (where noted)
rubrics_metrics.description: Joined cases are excluded from certain outcome counts and rate calculations (for example, outcomes by petition/patent FWD reporting and settlement rate calculations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report explicitly notes exclusions of joined cases for specified metrics; users should account for these exclusions when interpreting or reproducing the statistics.
